handoff.purpose: Define event dataclasses and the TransportRecord envelope with conversion from typed events.

symbols.note: Dataclass with three optional boolean fields, all default False.

symbols.name: SessionEnded
symbols.note: Dataclass with required session_id, exit_code, and optional stderr defaulting to empty string.

symbols.name: ToolRequested
symbols.note: Dataclass with tool_name, arguments dict, and call_id.

symbols.name: ToolCompleted
symbols.note: Dataclass with call_id, result, and is_error defaulting to False.

symbols.name: FileRead
symbols.note: Dataclass with path and content fields.

symbols.name: CommandOutput
symbols.note: Dataclass with command, output, and exit_code fields.

symbols.name: AgentMessage
symbols.note: Dataclass with content and role defaulting to 'assistant'.

symbols.name: AgentEvent
symbols.note: Union type alias covering all event dataclasses.

symbols.name: TransportRecord
symbols.note: Frozen dataclass representing an envelope with record_id, session_id, runtime, direction, sequence, event_type, timestamp, content, payload, metadata. Provides to_dict, from_dict, and embedding_text.

symbols.name: event_to_transport_record
symbols.note: Converts an AgentEvent into a TransportRecord, validating direction and generating content and event_type.

claims.text: Lossless envelope exchanged between a runtime shell and downstream sinks.
claims.why: The dataclass stores the full event payload and metadata; no information is discarded in to_dict or from_dict.

claims.text: Embeddings are derived from this record; they never replace its original payload or provenance.
claims.why: embedding_text returns a new string based on runtime/direction/event_type/content; the original payload and metadata fields remain untouched.

claims.text: Stable text projection used by an optional embedding index.
claims.why: The method constructs a deterministic string from runtime, direction, event_type, and content; it does not depend on mutable state.

claims.text: Wrap one typed event without discarding its provider-neutral payload.
claims.why: The function uses asdict(event) to capture all fields into payload, and the returned TransportRecord retains that payload.

observations.what: The TransportRecord.from_dict method coerces fields to str/int and provides defaults for missing 'content', 'payload', and 'metadata' keys.
The event_type conversion uses a regex that inserts underscores before uppercase letters, then lowercases. This matches standard camelCase to snake_case conversion for the event class names.
The direction validation restricts to {'input', 'output', 'system'}, and the record_id includes a zero-padded sequence number.
